subject: Connector duplicate usage — remediation plan, goodwill credit, and tax routing
messages:
From: Ella Martinez <ella@shoreline-sys.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Shoreline Systems Billing <billing@shoreline-sys.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Unexpected duplicate usage and GST misapplied on Nov invoices

Hi Mina,

We noticed a pretty large duplication in usage for two of our service tokens last billing period — it looks like the connector created duplicate ingestion jobs for a subset of customers and both jobs were billed. The attached CSV (usage-export-20261129.csv) highlights the duplicated lines: you can see the same session IDs billed twice between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-07.

On top of that, our APAC accounting team flagged GST on the invoice INV-9876 even though Shoreline is a Singapore-registered entity (GST-REG-78) and should not have India TDS/GST applied; the invoice shows a tax line that our AP team thinks is incorrect.

We need: 1) confirmation you'll reverse the duplicated charges (or issue a credit), 2) an adjusted invoice without the GST line, and 3) confirmation about how you will handle any withholding tax if our local bank has already withheld funds.

Can we get an ETA today? We're trying to close our month.

Thanks —
Ella Martinez
Head of Finance & Ops, Shoreline Systems
Phone: +65 9123 4567

Attachments:
- usage-export-20261129.csv (CSV stub, 42 rows)

On Mon, Nov 29, 2026 at 09:12 AM Ella Martinez <ella@shoreline-sys.com> wrote:
> See attached CSV with duplicated session IDs and the billing export.
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Martinez <ella@shoreline-sys.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Shoreline Systems Billing <billing@shoreline-sys.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate usage and GST misapplied on Nov invoices

Hi Ella — thanks for the export, and sorry for the disruption. I pulled the usage and connector logs and I can see the duplicated ingestion jobs you flagged.

Immediate plan (proposed):
- We will issue a credit memo for the duplicated usage lines and apply it to INV-9876 (or reissue an adjusted invoice if you prefer).
- We'll remove the GST line and reissue the invoice as an adjusted invoice (adjusted-invoice-INV-9876.pdf).
- For the goodwill/operational impact, I'm proposing a one-time service credit of USD 2,000 as a courtesy; that will be on a separate credit memo.

Two quick asks so we do this correctly on taxes:
1) Ella — can you confirm Shoreline's Singapore GST registration number (and whether the amount withheld by your bank was TDS under Indian rules or a local bank fee)?
2) Logan & Karthik — please advise on whether we should: (A) apply both credits as credit memos against the invoice, or (B) issue the duplicated amount as a wire refund and the goodwill amount as a credit memo to avoid tax withholding complications.

I'll hold action until I get your notes, but if you tell me you need the adjusted invoice before COB today I can prioritize. Attaching the incident report draft for internal tracking.

— Mina
Director, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- incident-report-connector.pdf (draft incident report)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate usage and GST misapplied on Nov invoices

Mina / Karthik — quick read on numbers: the duplicated usage lines in the CSV total USD 10,450. The goodwill credit proposed by Mina is USD 2,000; gross amount to correct = USD 12,450.

Recommendation (ops and tax-aware):
- Apply a credit memo for USD 10,450 to reverse the duplicate usage. That keeps our AR clean and ties to INV-9876.
- Apply the USD 2,000 goodwill as a separate credit memo but flag it as a non-taxable service credit in the memo notes.
- Reissue adjusted invoice (no GST line) and mark original INV-9876 as "superseded by credit memo/adjusted invoice". Attachments: we'll produce credit-memo-000123.pdf and adjusted-invoice-INV-9876.pdf.

If Shoreline's bank already withheld amounts under Indian TDS, the customer will need to provide withholding tax receipts; we can evaluate gross-up on a case-by-case basis, but default process is: credit memos + customer provides remittance evidence for any tax withheld and we follow up for either a gross-up payment or a refund.

Operational note: finance can issue the credit memos today if we get confirmation of the SG GST registration number and the customer's preference to take credit vs wire.

— Logan
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Ella Martinez <ella@shoreline-sys.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T12:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate usage and GST misapplied on Nov invoices

Thanks — quick tax guidance: Shoreline being SG-registered suggests GST should not have been treated as Indian GST/TDS. If Shoreline's AP team already had funds withheld under an Indian remit, we need remittance receipts to credit them appropriately.

Preferred flow to minimize friction:
1) Issue credit memos for both the duplicate usage (USD 10,450) and the goodwill credit (USD 2,000). Credit memos are cleaner for accounting and preserve our invoices.
2) Reissue the adjusted invoice without GST.
3) If Shoreline reports TDS withholding on the payment, request the bank tax certificate (Form 16A or equivalent) and we will either: (A) gross-up the credit amount to account for the withholding, or (B) issue a direct wire for the withheld portion after validation. We'll treat this as an exception and work with finance to close quickly.

Note: If the customer prefers an immediate wire for the duplicate amount to avoid their AR reconciliation friction, we can do that — but we should only wire after confirming identity and banking details, and we'll still issue credit memos in our system to clear the invoice.

— Karthik
Head of Tax & Legal Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Martinez <ella@shoreline-sys.com>, Shoreline Systems Billing <billing@shoreline-sys.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate usage and GST misapplied on Nov invoices — actions taken

Hi Ella — quick update and final confirmation of actions taken: thank you for the quick turnaround on the CSV and GST registration number (GST-SG-78). Per your note we proceeded with the following this morning: 

1) Credit memos issued: credit-memo-000123.pdf covers duplicated usage (USD 10,450) and credit-memo-000124.pdf covers the goodwill credit (USD 2,000). Both memos have been applied to INV-9876 and the original invoice is marked as superseded.
2) Adjusted invoice (adjusted-invoice-INV-9876.pdf) has been uploaded to your billing portal and attached here. It reflects the removal of GST and the net due is adjusted accordingly.
3) If Shoreline's bank withheld any TDS/GST, please send the remittance evidence (bank certificate/Form 16A or equivalent). Per Karthik's guidance we will either gross-up or issue a supplemental wire to make Shoreline whole.

Attachments included in this message:
- credit-memo-000123.pdf (duplicate usage reversal)
- adjusted-invoice-INV-9876.pdf (reissued, no GST)
- incident-report-connector.pdf (finalized)

Ella — can you confirm receipt and that these documents satisfy your AP team so you can close the month? If you'd prefer an outright wire for the duplicate usage amount, let me know and we'll open the wire request (we'll need beneficiary details and an authorized signature from Shoreline). Otherwise the credits will appear on your account and clear against future invoices.

Apologies again for the disruption — we've disabled the problematic ingestion rule and added a monitoring alert to prevent recurrence. HubSpot case: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/case/SHR-2026-119.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
